## Flagship Open-Source Software (MIT)
- [MHS Download Manager](https://github.com/sshihabb007/MHS-DOWNLOAD-MANAGER): Clean-room Windows x64 download accelerator (`C# .NET 4.8`), 14-browser Manifest V3 extension, pure C# lossless MP4/WebM/MKV muxer, BitTorrent/Debrid, and 15-tool MCP server.
- [Driver+](https://github.com/sshihabb007/DriverPlus): Native 64-bit Windows 10/11 official WHQL driver updater (432 KB portable, zero telemetry), 14 Game Runtimes & Event ID 1000 Crash DLL Doctor, Rescue Center, and HVCI auditor.
- [Video Speed Controller — VSC](https://github.com/sshihabb007/VSC): Lightweight Manifest V3 HTML5 video/audio speed controller for Chrome and Brave with Shadow DOM isolation and per-site positioning studio.
- [MASTER VPN PRO](https://github.com/sshihabb007/MASTER-VPN-PRO): Multi-platform open-source VPN and privacy shield across Windows Desktop, Chrome/Brave MV3 Extension, and signed Android APK.
